QF.id: AIFM CIII Governance and Due Diligence_28

question.text: Under SEBI's Cyber Security and Cyber Resilience Framework (CSCRF) classification, the CATEGORISATION of an AIF manager as Qualified RE / Mid-size / Small-size / Self-certification RE is based on:

answer.text: Geographic location of the manager's head office
Sum of corpus of all AIFs/VCFs and their schemes managed by the Manager (clubbed at MANAGER level, not fund-level)

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per SEBI Circular (April 30, 2025), categorisation is done at the MANAGER LEVEL (not fund-level). Criteria: Mid-size RE = Rs. 10,000 cr and above; Small-size RE = more than Rs. 3,000 cr and less than Rs. 10,000 cr; Self-certification RE = Rs. 3,000 cr and below. If manager also manages VCFs, their corpus is clubbed for threshold computation. **The Trap:** SCORES complaint count, head-office location and Aadhaar status are unrelated criteria. **Cross-Exam Context:** CSCRF is tested across XIX-C/D/E as a new operational-risk topic; exam favours numeric thresholds. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Before year-end close, forecast whether your manager's combined AIF+VCF AUM will cross the 3,000 cr or 10,000 cr threshold — a category upgrade triggers Market-SOC (M-SOC) requirement and substantial cyber-spend; budget early.
